description: A sprite sheet of TWELVE separate food item icons arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell. Row 1 raw ingredients: a raw chicken drumstick, a raw marbled beef steak, a raw lamb chop with bone, a raw pink fish fillet. Row 2 cooked dishes: a golden roast chicken on a plate, a bowl of hearty beef stew with carrots, three grilled lamb skewers, a whole grilled fish on a plate with lemon. Row 3 cooked dishes: a bowl of creamy fish soup, fried rice served in a hollowed pineapple, a bowl of orange pumpkin soup, a slice of strawberry cream cake. Chunky simple game item icons, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every item fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
